## 3. Manufacturing Work Procedure

### 3.1 Querying the Raw Material Input List Before Mixing

Query the raw material input list before mixing and apply the specified conditions to extract the required information.

Enter the query conditions as shown below.

|Input item|Input value|Remarks|
|---|---|---|
|Plant|BK01|Fixed value|
|Supply Type|1|Fixed value|
|Line Code|Blank|When querying stock for all lines|
|Cost Center|Blank|When querying stock for all lines|
|Query reference date|Day of work| |

After Excel Download of the query result, extract the required information.

![img021](<img021.png "Raw material input list query screen">)

1) Select the raw material input list query menu on the Favorites tab.
2) Enter the input values from the table above in the query conditions at the top.
3) Select the query button and check the result.
4) Select the Excel Download button and save the result as a file.

If the query returns 0 records, re-check the query conditions; if it still returns 0 records after re-querying, report to the shift leader

[PAGE 9]

### 3.2 Weighing and Checking Raw Materials

Based on the extracted list, compare the part number, quantity and LOT No. of the raw materials to be fed against the actual items.

|Check item|Check method|Acceptance criterion|
|---|---|---|
|Part number|Compare the list with the raw material label|Match|
|Weighed weight|Weigh on an electronic scale|Within ±1.0% of the formula sheet|
|LOT No.|Check the raw material label|Matches the lot stated on the list|
|Expiry date|Check the raw material label|At least 7 days remaining as of the work date|
|Appearance|Visual check|No foreign matter, lumps or discoloration|

Raw materials found to be inconsistent in the comparison are not fed and are isolated in the nonconforming product area.

**Caution:**Raw materials whose LotNo. cannot be verified must not be fed under any circumstances.

Allergen raw materials (wheat, egg, milk, soybean) are weighed with dedicated weighing tools; the same tools as for general raw materials are not used.

![img022](<img022.png "Position of LOT No. and expiry date on the raw material label">)

Record the part number, weighed weight, LOT No. and the person who weighed in the mixing record (WI-BK-204).

[PAGE 10]

### 3.3 Preheating the Proofing Room and Ovens

Before starting work, check that preheating of the proofing room and ovens is complete and record the result.

-Preheating is judged complete when the temperature displayed on the equipment reaches the reference range.
-The checker is the operator in person, and the time of the check is recorded.
-Dough is not loaded during preheating.

The preheating criteria for each piece of equipment are as follows.

|Equipment|Preheating criterion|Preheating time|
|---|---|---|
|Proofing room|32 ± 2℃ / relative humidity 75 ± 5% |approx. 30 min|
|#1 oven|180 ± 5℃|approx. 40 min|
|#2 oven|180 ± 5℃|approx. 40 min|
|Deck oven|200 ± 10℃|approx. 20 min|

Record the result in the daily equipment checklist.

|Record item|Record content|
|---|---|
|Date and time of check|Time at which completion of preheating was confirmed|
|Equipment number|Proofing room/#1/#2/Deck|
|Displayed temperature|Temperature displayed on the equipment at the time of the check<br>For the proofing room, record both temperature and relative humidity|
|Checker|Name of the operator|

![img023](<img023.png "Temperature and humidity display on the proofing room control panel">)

**Work must not be started before the reference temperature has been reached.**

If the reference temperature is not reached even after the preheating time exceeds the standard time, notify the person in charge of the equipment.

[PAGE 11]

### 3.4 Storage of Refrigerated Raw Materials

Unopened refrigerated raw materials (butter, fresh cream, liquid egg) are stored in the range of 2~8℃.

- Check the storage temperature at least 1 time every day
- If it is outside the reference range, notify the quality manager immediately.
- Opened raw materials are marked with the opening date and used within 24 hours after opening.

|Raw material|Storage temperature|Check frequency|
|---|---|---|
|Butter|2~8℃|At least 1 time per 1 day| 
|Fresh cream|2~8℃|At least 1 time per 1 day| 
|Liquid egg|2~8℃|2 times per 1 day| 
|Frozen dough|-18℃ or below|At least 1 time per 1 day|

### 3.5 Actions When an Abnormality Occurs

If an equipment abnormality occurs during work, stop the line immediately, report to the shift leader, and keep a record of the actions taken.

- When an abnormality is found, the operator stops loading additional dough.
- Record the stop time and the abnormality in the equipment abnormality history.
- Work is not resumed without confirmation by the shift leader.
- Products made in the section where the abnormality occurred are segregated and submitted to the quality manager for a decision.

The metal detector is a critical control point (CCP); if a malfunction is confirmed, all products made after that point are put on hold.
